birthday-calculator.quickAnswer: Enter your birthdate and the calculator works out your exact age today - for example, born 10 March 2000 means 26 years, 7 months and 8 days old on 18 October 2026 - plus a countdown to your next birthday (143 days away, on 10 March 2027, a Wednesday) and the weekday you were born on (Friday).
keyFacts: Your age in years, months and days is counted like an odometer: full years first, then leftover months, then leftover days.
The next-birthday countdown uses calendar days, so it is exact even across leap years.
Knowing the weekday you were born on is just calendar math - no astrology involved.
People born on 29 February legally celebrate on 28 February or 1 March in non-leap years; this tool counts down to 28 February.
The day-of-year number tells you how far through the year a birthday falls - day 69 of 365, for example.
howTo: Enter your birthdate with the date picker.
Your exact age in years, months and days appears instantly.
See how many days remain until your next birthday, with its date and weekday.
Discover which weekday you were born on.
Share the countdown with friends - the numbers update every day.
birthday-calculator.formula:
Age = today minus birthdate.
Full years = complete calendar years since birth.
Remaining months/days = leftover after removing the full years.
Days to next birthday = next birthday date minus today.
Example: born 2000-03-10, today 2026-10-18 -> 26 years, 7 months, 8 days; next birthday in 143 days.
birthday-calculator.workedExample:
Birthdate: 10 March 2000. Today: 18 October 2026.
1. Full years: 10 March 2000 to 10 March 2026 = 26 years.
2. Leftover months: 10 March 2026 to 10 October 2026 = 7 months.
3. Leftover days: 10 October to 18 October = 8 days.
4. Age: 26 years, 7 months, 8 days.
5. Next birthday: 10 March 2027, which is 143 days away and falls on a Wednesday.
6. Born on: 10 March 2000 was a Friday.
benefits: One page for your exact age, countdown and birthday trivia.
Countdowns make great screenshots for birthday invitations.
No sign-up and no data stored - safe for children's birthdates too.
Updates automatically every day you open it.
limitations: 29 February birthdays are counted down to 28 February in non-leap years - a common convention, not a legal rule.
Age is calendar-based; it does not measure biological or developmental age.
Time zones are ignored; the countdown uses your device's local date.
Dates before 1900 may not display correctly in every browser.

faqs.q: How is my exact age calculated?
faqs.a: By counting full calendar years from your birthdate to today, then the leftover whole months, then the leftover days - the same way people state their age in years, months and days.

faqs.q: I was born on 29 February. When is my next birthday?
faqs.a: This tool counts down to 28 February in non-leap years, which is the most common convention. Your legal birthday may differ by country - some use 1 March.

faqs.q: Why does the countdown change by one each day?
faqs.a: Because it counts whole calendar days remaining. It ticks over at midnight in your device's local time.

faqs.q: What day of the week was I born on?
faqs.a: Enter your birthdate and the 'born on' result shows it - pure calendar math, accurate for any date in the supported range.

faqs.q: Can I check someone else's birthday?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter any birthdate - the tool stores nothing, so it is safe to use for family and friends.

faqs.q: Does it work for future birthdates?
faqs.a: No - a birthdate in the future gives no meaningful age. The tool expects a date in the past.
